messages:
Alan: FYI node gpu-37 (eu-west-2) auto-drained after repeated Xid=86 + ECC spikes. Creating RMA.

ops-bot: [alert] node/gpu-37 drained by healthcheck (reason: ECC threshold). Incident INC-20240315-782

Lina: Please paste serials + vendor ticket. Also what spare pool?

Alan: Vendor ticket VND-4921
Alan: Serials:
```
GPU0 Serial: SN-GPU-003421
GPU1 Serial: SN-GPU-003422  <-- flapping
GPU2 Serial: SN-GPU-003423
```
Alan: dmesg shows Xid 86 floods around 2024-03-15T09:12Z

Maria: We prefer EU-LON depot to avoid cross-region fees. Do we have cold spares on-hand?

Kevin: Inventory shows 2 cold spares in EU-LON but one is reserved. Checking hold status.

warehouse-bot: Picklist PL-8892 created with SN-SPARE-045 & SN-SPARE-046. ETA to depot 2bd.

vendor-ops: VND-4921 received. Depot intake flagged tamper=1; need ops authorization before unseal. ETA pickup 48-72h if cleared.

Alan: We did not authorize unseal. Who flagged tamper?

Kevin: Depot logged seal mismatch; looks like outbound manifest mismatch. Investigating picklist generation.

Lina: Do NOT accept tampered hardware without ops sign-off. Vendor please attach intake photos/logs to VND-4921.

Vendor-ops: Photo attached. Need RMA manifest id to map serials and clear hold.

Alan: Our manifest excerpt:
```
manifest_id: MAN-2024-03-15-77
replacements:
 - SN-SPARE-045 -> gpu-37
 - SN-SPARE-047 -> reserved
```
Note: SN-SPARE-046 not present but used by picklist.

Kevin: Nightly manifest sync failed at 03:00Z; picklist retried and pulled stale inventory. Re-running reconcile.

Maria: If reconcile takes time, quarantine SN-SPARE-046 and pull SN-SPARE-045. Can we hot-swap remotely to keep downtime <10m?

Alan: Yes hot-swap is fine. I'll cordon and coordinate with SRE Oncall.

Vendor-ops: Holding inbound at depot until manual intake. Will not unseal or sign-off without ops note.

Warehouse-bot: Picklist updated -> PL-8892-V2 with SN-SPARE-045 active.

Lina: Alan please paste short nvidia-smi ECC snippet and lspci output into the ticket.

Alan: ECC snippet:
```
volatile: 120
aggregate: 502
```
Also `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=serial,ecc.errors.volatile --format=csv` added to ticket.

Kevin: Reconcile finished. SN-SPARE-045 reserved for gpu-37. SN-SPARE-046 quarantined (QTN-113). Manifest pushed to vendor S3.

Vendor-ops: Manifest received. We'll clear hold once chain-of-custody text added to VND-4921.

Lina: Chain-of-custody: "Handed to depot EU-LON by Redwood Ops on 2024-03-12; return scanned 2024-03-14; seal mismatch recorded; replacement authorized SN-SPARE-045."

Alan: Added to ticket.

Vendor-ops: Hold cleared. Replacement SN-SPARE-045 scheduled depot-to-customer, tracking TRK-EULON-7701. :shipit:

Maria: Please add small postmortem to INC-20240315-782 about manifest-sync bug; add owners.

Kevin: I'll own the PM and open PR to add webhook retry + alert.

Alan: Hot-swap in 30m with SRE Oncall. Will report node health after rejoin.

ops-bot: [event] replacement scheduled TRK-EULON-7701 ETA 2024-03-16T09:00Z

Alan: Node rejoined, no ECC increments after 2h. Closing local incident. Attaching logs to INC-20240315-782.

Lina: Good job. Filing follow-up for manifest reliability. :thumbsup:

Alan: Closing thread.
